question: Will the 10-year U.S. Treasury par yield (Treasury daily par yield curve) for 2025-01-13 (or the last business day before it with a published reading) be above 4.08%, its value for 2024-10-11?

rule.threshold_basis: the latest reading as of 2024-10-15 (2024-10-11), rounded as shown

source: Source: U.S. Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service
